pub struct Object {
    claim: Claim,
    context: String,
    key: String,
    source_base: usize,
    flags: u64,
    sites: Vec<(String, Span)>,
    sources: Vec<String>,
    messages: Vec<String>,
    code: Linkable,
    payload: Vec<u8>,
    code_start: usize,
    code_length: usize,
}

struct Relocations<'a> {
    file: &'a mut File,
    buffer: Vec<u8>,
    at: usize,
    available: usize,
    unread: usize,
    remaining: usize,
    hash: crate::sha256::Sha256,
}

struct PatchWindow<'a> {
    file: &'a mut File,
    buffer: Vec<u8>,
    start: usize,
    length: usize,
    image_length: usize,
    dirty: bool,
}

review.mode: independent static source review only; no rerun
review.result: No concrete binding/proof substitution hole found; cold compiler pin remains trusted caller input.

scope.cold_producer: The trusted caller supplies the exact checker/compiler identity; the API does not infer executable provenance from a byte label.
limits: Not a package principal or a general per-package capability ceiling.
No promise about future template instantiation or later invocation of returned callables.
Only the concrete projected export graphs, not every unexported body, are claimed.
The wrapper is an opt-in native admission consumer; ordinary compiler/driver routes are unchanged.
scope.native_consumer: A private noncloneable Admission owns the CheckedUnit or authenticated Interface. Consuming emit/open methods compare the exact compiler/name/input/body/interface/dependencies Binding, re-evaluate current policy and reject changed policy identity. Cached native payloads authenticate against that same owned interface.
scope.proof: After specialization, all selected interface functions' authenticated transitive operation summaries satisfy a versioned closed allowlist. Custom and structural cleanup are included by checked-unit effects.
